strongestCompressionAttempt.shape: ordinary F1-F9 State/Relation/Transition + F6 authority/provenance + GDF0 EffectiveRuleTopology, with no named GDF3 responsibility
strongestCompressionAttempt.reason: the substrate can encode every instance, but without a Game-owned case-determination contract repeated cross-regime anti-collapse distinctions are not required to remain jointly queryable: official case status can be confused with WorldTruth, classification/advice with binding status, current determination with enforcement, and supersession with history rewrite. This is analogous to GDF1 GameActionContract being a responsibility contract over F1-F9 rather than a new primitive.

fieldDeletionTests.lossIfAbsentEntirely: VALID/FOUL/OUT/RECORD can become unscoped status tokens; a determination relation must still identify what proposition/action/history/performance/status is being determined

fieldDeletionTests.lossIfMergedUntyped: evidence/world/canonical-state basis can be confused with norm/evaluation basis
same evidence with different current rule/interpretation cannot be distinguished from changed evidence

fieldDeletionTests.lossIfAbsentEntirely: same classification by analyst vs referee/judge cannot distinguish advisory from binding
there is no object/status relation representing which case result currently binds the Game/Practice
historical/current, match/tournament/category and authority-source distinctions collapse
review/reversal cases cannot reconstruct supersession, but ordinary event/provenance history can supply it without core field
none inside determination identity; ruling/enforcement separation is maintained by ordinary transition relations outside core contract

minimalContract.name: AuthoritativeCaseDeterminationContract
minimalContract.responsibility: When a Game/PlayPractice makes a case-level status determination that is binding independently enough to matter, preserve a typed relation identifying the determination target/status and the current authority/provenance that makes it binding; preserve typed determination basis links when changing case/evidence basis versus norm/evaluation/application basis creates a distinct counterfactual. Review/lineage and enforcement remain derived/external relations.
minimumObligations: DeterminationTargetAndStatus: identify what case proposition/action/history/performance/status is being authoritatively determined and what current status/result binds
BindingAuthorityAndCurrentness: preserve the F5/F6 scope/currentness/provenance relation that makes this result authoritative rather than advice/classification/proposal
TypedDeterminationBasisWhenMaterial: distinguish case/evidence/canonical-state basis from norm/evaluation/application basis when those can vary independently

adjudicationBoundary.positiveTest: a determination has Game/Practice-authoritative status that can vary independently from underlying event/history/action execution, or its authority/basis/currentness can vary while the underlying event is held fixed
adjudicationBoundary.negativeTest: ordinary deterministic execution/admission where result is merely the direct current transition semantics and no independently meaningful case-status/authority/basis lineage exists need not instantiate a separate adjudicative record
